contract_completeness: Every required field has an explicit JSON type, shape, defining equation or predicate, and canonicalization rule.

tv_V.canonicalization: exact rational, strictly smaller than tv_W
tv_V.definition: half L1 distance between selected V rows

tv_W.definition: half L1 distance between selected W rows

witness_row_pair.canonicalization: i<j, max gap then smallest pair
witness_row_pair.definition: tie-broken pair [i,j] witnessing strict TV contraction

representation_conventions: Indices are zero-based unless a mathematical exponent or degree is explicitly named. Matrices are row-major; nested tensor array order is stated per task.

A rational scalar is a reduced JSON string "n" or "n/d" with positive denominator. JSON integers are used only where the field contract says integer. Floats, decimal approximations, NaN and infinity are invalid.
The submission object has exactly required_fields, with no additional keys. Nested objects likewise use exactly the named keys.
task_rules: Rows are input symbols and columns are output symbols. A garbling T has shape columns(W) by columns(V), nonnegative rational entries, every row summing to 1, and W*T=V.
For rows i<j, TV_W=1/2 sum_y |W[i,y]-W[j,y]| and similarly for V. Select the pair maximizing TV_W-TV_V, breaking ties by smaller i then smaller j.
Positive sets list, in increasing column order, exactly those columns where row i is strictly larger than row j; the selected witness must have TV_W>TV_V.
